summary: English and Vietnamese first-party discovery identified the HCMC DONRE Geoportal's Củ Chi land-use-status catalog record and the national land-inventory application. Direct catalog access timed out; the national application exposed only public region metadata while configuration/search endpoints were login-required or unavailable. No anonymous safe parcel ID-plus-geometry response was qualified and no sample was retained.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: All executed discovery queries, URLs, direct requests, status outcomes, schema/CRS checks, safe field allowlist, scope limits, and uncertainty are recorded in city-5299-c-chi.json. No login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, credentials, private tokens, TLS bypass, or unsafe-field request occurred.

custodians.name: Ho Chi Minh City DONRE Geoportal
custodians.scope: Local/provincial government geospatial catalog with a specifically indexed Củ Chi land-use-status dataset; parcel-vector access was not qualified.

custodians.name: Department of Land Administration, Viet Nam
custodians.scope: National land-inventory/statistics application; public region metadata was accessible, but parcel search/configuration required login or was unavailable.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native cadastral parcel identifier only if source-proven
full parcel polygon geometry only when safely returned
scopeLimits: The exact WUP point and population are preserved in the city record.
Timeout, login-required, and not-found outcomes are access/qualification results, not evidence of parcel absence.
No anonymous ID-plus-geometry response, parcel schema, CRS, or citywide vector coverage was qualified.
No unsafe land-record fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion is not source integration/admission.
uncertainty: The catalog's current OGC service configuration could not be inspected because the direct request timed out.
The national application's public shell does not establish open cadastral parcel access.
No independent runtime adapter qualification was performed.
